notes.title: Fixed a bug browsing messages after replying to the first in a list
notes.content: Fixed an issue not being able to flip through messages after replying to the first in a list of requests for comfort, media recommendations or poetry challenges.

notes.title: No, really. You'll never climb that tree again.
notes.content:
Trees impervious
 Wiggling lines from pibbles fixed
 Calmer memory room shader
 Fixed all clothes being described as "1920x1080"
 Rewrote first gating narrative because calling the button "broken" confused people

notes.title: Luigi dares you to still climb trees
notes.content:
Fixed a bug preventing players from using new stickers.
 Reducing tree climbability
 Highlight make request as alternative option to respond to request when waiting for go outside button to be “fixed”
 Fixed unfavorite confirm menu in memories space
 Fixed activating an entrance or map you're already standing next to
 Added menu button to memories room. Changed “back” to “Go Outside”
 Prevented opening menu when exiting home, vintage shop and fashion shop

notes.title: Sturdier rocks. MacOS windowed. Slug.
notes.content:
Many collider improvements
 Forcing MacOS to start in windowed mode while I chase the enforced double click and other bugs
 Outskirts airplane camera doesn't show the insides of people's heads
 Fixed some typos.
 Better mug mug particles
 Fixed Banini slug display
 Chain forest has exit sign, not bus stop

notes.title: Intel Mac. Fairer Forest.
notes.content:
Added missing MacOS Intel build
 Chain forest visual improvements


It felt like I did a lot more today, but a lot of that was on the server side. Because all you beautiful playtesters showed up and I discovered how broken some things were there.

notes.title: Fixes and eyes
notes.content:
Customizable eye styles (only 3, more to come)
 Improved eye movements
 Life tips can be reported and favorited
 Bus stop in chain forest
 Fixed losing place in inbox after receiving a new sticker
 You can no longer thank the same message twice
 Wiggling void looks around
 Room object inspection camera fixes
 Fixed some z-fighting in the vintage shop
 Traffic cone and ella's hat texture holes filled
 Removing items from inbox after responding to them
 Made old, unopened letters sort to the front
 Fixed not being able to favorite letters that were just opened

notes.title: Ella is better behaved.
notes.content:
fixed bugs with ella's announcements
 fixed visual issue with conversation reporting
 no more clicking on airplanes while leaving home
 improved behavior when using down arrow to exit text input boxes
 prevented airplane text from appearing on top of report interface
 fixed knee jerk in idle animation

notes.title: Faster. More reliable.
notes.content:
More reliable room selection menu
 Significantly faster cache writing routines for less stuttering
 New input layout just for changing signatures
 Removed audio baked in to moments videos which didn't respect audio settings
 Cafe and Vintage shop menus look more like the home room menu
